# PLLM

Release: 0.1.0
Build: sha256:5305ca7ad557c9bb6bc08f507fdb6c80bb709c09979323514d5730cb3edd75f9

Private LLM inference documentation. Public weights; provider follows the protocol.

- [Reference](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference.md)): Look up exact CLI commands, Python APIs, schemas, components, and current support.
- [Python API inventory](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference/python/pllm/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference/python/pllm.md)): Public Python classes, functions, and evidence APIs in the installed package.
- [Component catalog](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference/components/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference/components.md)): Built-in component records with implementation, coverage, and evidence status.
- [Schema reference](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference/schemas/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference/schemas.md)): Versioned schemas for configurations, plans, evidence, assurance, and research records.
- [Current support](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference/status/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference/status.md)): What you can use today, what remains experimental, and what is not yet supported.
- [Implementation map](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/agents/implementation-map/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/agents/implementation-map.md)): Locate model planning, compiler contracts, native execution, Python APIs, CLI code, schemas, and documentation.
- [Agents](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/agents/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/agents.md)): Find the code and records used for implementation, research, and reproduction work.
- [Add a category](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/add-a-category/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/add-a-category.md)): Extend the semantic component graph when an existing category cannot express a real contract.
- [Component standard](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/component-standard/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/component-standard.md)): Required identity, lifecycle, representation, role, capability, evidence, and limitation fields.
- [Contribute](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute.md)): Add a model, component, research method, or evidence record without creating a one-off runtime path.
- [Native plugin ABI](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/native-plugin-abi/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/native-plugin-abi.md)): Boundary requirements for future independently distributed native capability providers.
- [Publish a provider](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/publish-a-provider/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/publish-a-provider.md)): Expose a component implementation without importing it during core discovery.
- [Upstreaming](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/upstreaming/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/contribute/upstreaming.md)): Move validated research work into maintained semantic and runtime components.
- [Native reference](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference/native/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference/native.md)): Rust crates, the Python binding, data ownership, threading, and ABI support.
- [Python reference](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference/python/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/reference/python.md)): The installed pllm namespace and its generated public API inventory.
